title: GENERATXOR
tagline: The focus for this project was NFT creation and storage with interaction on layer one and layer two.
description:
Dapp that is a tool used to generate decentralized widgets.
This is a multipurpose dapp created using the diamond standard for modularity. The dapp can be used to create and store NFTs and other data on IPFS, trade NFT and other tokens. Participate in staking, yield farming and other interactions within the DEFI system. It is also meant to operate on layer one and layer2.
how_its_made: Solidity, Hardhat, Typescript, React. Used the Diamond standard to give the option for modularity. Creating multiple contracts (libraries) that can be used across many contracts to provide a broad range of functionality with a fun and useful interface. Because of the focus on the diamond standard and typescript it became very complicated and will need more time to fully develop.
